sources.summary: The UDL Thesis Publication Seminar 2026 is a two-day international online seminar organized by Urban Design Lab, bringing together selected undergraduate and postgraduate thesis projects from across the world in the fields of urban design, landscape architecture, architecture, and planning. The 2026 edition brings together 40 outstanding thesis abstracts from submissions across 15 countries. Selected for their originality, relevance, research quality, and innovation, the projects explore contemporary urban challenges and emerging approaches to the future of cities. The seminar will take place online on 12 and 13 September 2026 and is structured around four thematic areas: Urban Landscape, Urban Management, Urban Networks,
